title: Caterpillar TV Nightmare
description: A surreal scene featuring a cracked old television on a dusty wooden desk displaying a monstrous grinning caterpillar creature with sharp teeth and multiple eyes. A giant decayed hand grips the TV from behind while smoke, paint tubes, scattered Cheerios, and child shadow silhouettes with halos cover a peeling purple wall under a single hanging lightbulb.
